title: Nash Equilibrium
description: A set of choices where nobody does better by changing alone. Nash proved every game has one, if chance is allowed.

puzzle.goal: Two firms sell the same thing; its price is A − B·(all they make), and each pays c a unit. Write how much Q each makes when neither can earn more by changing alone.
puzzle.name: Cournot duopoly
puzzle.ask: Find Q for A = @{A}, c = @{c} and B = @{B}.
puzzle.method: Each firm's best output is (A − c − B·other)/(2B). Where the two best answers meet, both make (A − c)/(3B).
